details.html:
• Our leather jewellery and belts are crafted from 100% natural leather. Natural marks and textures are part of what gives each piece its individuality and timeless appeal.
  • To preserve the appearance and longevity of your leather pieces, avoid exposure to water, oils, perfumes, cosmetics, and household cleaning products, as these can stain, dry out, or damage the leather. Remove leather items before bathing, swimming, or exercising.
  • If cleaning is required, gently wipe with a soft, dry cloth. Do not soak or wash leather, and avoid using soaps, solvents, or abrasive cleaners.
  • When not in use, store leather jewellery and belts in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight and heat. Avoid tightly folding or compressing leather to help maintain its shape and finish.
